dos.text: Set headingLevel to 1-6 if you want the legend rendered as a heading element, anything else (including the default -1) falls through to a plain legend since HEADING_LEVEL_TEMPLATES only has entries for 1 through 6.

donts.text: Don't toggle disabled off on the fieldset expecting individually-disabled children to stay disabled, #updateChildDisabledState() runs querySelectorAll("*") over every descendant exposing a disabled or parentDisabled property and unconditionally clears/sets disabled on all of them with no per-child state tracking.

behavior.text: Setting inputsRole moves role plus the accessible name, description, and orientation off the outer fieldset onto the #inputs container instead, so the slotted inputs present collectively as e.g. a radiogroup; the outer fieldset gets role="presentation" and loses those attributes.

configuration.text: supportPage and the support-link slot are mutually gated: the slot only renders when supportPage is unset, setting supportPage replaces it with a built-in moz-support-link instead.
